title: Validator and Gate Logging Scalability Upgrade
goal: Upgrade governance validation and gate logging so large patch chains and recursive evidence trees remain auditable without causing SQLite payload failures, database lock contention, or validator timeouts.

observed_failures: patch-gate logged path can fail with sqlite3.DataError: string or blob too big
global_validate.py can exceed the normal execution window after large recursive governance evidence expansion
aborted validation may leave lingering Python processes and temporary SQLite lock contention
problem_statement.known_root_cause: scripts/query_governance.py serialized oversized recursive evidence_json payloads into SQLite decision logs, especially patch_chain.dependency_results and evidence_paths.

basis.scope: Compact governance decision logging and introduce bounded validation modes without changing semantic patch content or RT_core.

required_repo_changes.description: Write compact SQLite decision logs, externalize bounded evidence bundles, and preserve gate decisions when logging fails.
Add bounded validation modes, stage timing, stage trace classification, and a lightweight DB runtime probe.
Document the new bounded validator modes and stage-trace behavior.

decision_log_compaction: full recursive evidence tree replaced with bounded audit metadata

acceptance_criteria: Logged patch-gate for PATCH_PI_RT_CALCULUS_059 completes without sqlite3.DataError.
patch-chain for PATCH_PI_RT_CALCULUS_059 still returns allow or applied-style status.
Decision log contains compact evidence with full_evidence_hash and full_evidence_path.
Externalized full evidence file exists and hash matches the decision-log reference.
No RT Calculus patch content is modified.

warnings: Compact decision-log evidence is persisted in SQLite and bounded external evidence bundles are written under outputs/governance/evidence/.
